conf.description: FireEye AX ax-alert LEEF notification feed: header split + named key=value attribute decode (LEEF names fields explicitly, no cs/cn slot ambiguity), best-effort devTime parse (no devTimeFormat supplied), keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / ax-alert / syslog-leef. LEEF:1.0 header (Version|Vendor|Product|Version|EventID|) then key=value attrs, tokenized with a whitespace/caret lookahead so embedded spaces in request survive. Header field 5 (eventType) is mapped to event.action by analogy with the sibling CEF format's header 'name' field - it is not its own fields[] row in the work order, flagged in README same as the nx-alert LEEF pipeline's precedent for this exact judgment call. No severity field is documented for AX LEEF, so event.severity is left unmapped on this transport - not invented. No os-changes trace on this transport by construction; the analyst pivot to the full detonation trace is the link deep link.

functions.description: record approach and the eventType-by-analogy / no-severity gaps
split the 5 pipe-delimited LEEF header fields plus the trailing attribute blob (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since unanchored)
tokenize the named-key attribute blob, map every documented key to ECS/custom targets, best-effort devTime parse, header eventType to event.action by CEF-precedent analogy, cleanup
